summary: Mottainai is a tight, cutthroat card game where every card in your hand is simultaneously a potential task, material, or work, forcing constant hard choices about what to sacrifice for what. Games are short but tense, since the follow mechanic means your opponents often benefit from the action you choose to take, so timing and reading the table matter as much as your own plan.
praised: Incredible depth and replayability packed into a small deck and quick playtime
Every card being usable in multiple ways creates constant meaningful decisions
Tight, elegant design typical of Carl Chudyk (Innovation, Glory to Rome)
Fast setup and teardown, good for repeated plays in one sitting
criticised: Steep learning curve and unintuitive rules text that make teaching it hard
Can feel fiddly or 'crunchy' for such a short, small game
Some multi-use card text is dense and requires reference/cheat sheets
Two-player experience is considered weaker than with more players

interaction.kind: follow/role-selection interaction where your chosen action lets others act too

win_criteria: Most points, one or two sources

scoring.why: Winning comes down to efficiently completing high-value works while managing scarce materials, so a well-timed focused engine beats spreading effort thin
